about_the_game:
"Elemental Aspirations" is a tactical turn-based Roguelike RPG where players control Elise, a silver-haired maiden, and her congenitally deformed dragon companion Pipi. Together, they embark on a journey to the Thunder Realm above the clouds - the ancestral home of true dragons - to help Pipi return to his roots before his final moments.

Elemental Reactions
The game features five core elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Wood, and Thunder. All element-charged entities are interactive. When any two objects/entities with different elements come into contact, they trigger elemental reactions. Notably, the effects vary depending on whether the reactants are objects or terrain surfaces. Master environmental interactions through magical manipulation to unleash devastating elemental combinations.

Chain Reactions
Elemental reactions aren't limited to Elise's spells - elemental energies released from reactions can overflow and trigger new reactions. Strategically use single skill casts to initiate catastrophic reaction chains! Skilled players might even defeat entire enemy groups with one well-placed ability.

Rich Narrative & Dynamic Events
The game world comprises five elemental realms (Fire, Water, Earth, Wood, Thunder), each containing dozens of unique event zones. Players will revisit zones multiple times, with each visit triggering new story-driven events directly tied to game progression. Every zone contains at least three distinct event phases that unfold new storylines based on the player's main quest progression and related event completion. Uncover ancient secrets hidden across realms to reveal the world's truth.

200+ Treasures & Unique Roguelike Runs
After each victorious battle, Elise gains powerful artifacts from a pool of over 200 unique treasures. Combine these to create diverse builds and experiment with varied combat styles in each playthrough.

Alchemy System & Botanical Cultivation
Defeated enemies across realms drop elemental seeds. Cultivate these in your home base to harvest materials of varying rarities. Combine monster drops with cultivated resources in the alchemy system to:

  • Craft potent potions

  • Unlock new abilities

  • Create various items
    Rarer materials yield more powerful creations. When facing overwhelming challenges, leverage alchemy to gain crucial advantages!

Key Features Highlighted:

  • Strategic elemental interaction system

  • Dynamic reaction chains

  • Branching narrative with 50+ event zones

  • Deep progression with 200+ combinable treasures

  • Integrated cultivation/alchemy mechanics

  • Replayable Roguelike structure

short_description: Wield magic to interact with elemental objects and terrain, triggering diverse Elemental Reactions to defeat enemies and gather treasures for crafting. Accompany Elise to escort Pipi a deformed-winged dragon hatchling exiled across the Cloudspire Peaks, embarking on a journey to reclaim its origin.
